about.title: About IDAROOM
about.intro: IDAROOM is a hybrid (Online/Offline) digital environment built specifically for Algerian middle and high schools.
about.p1_desc: Fully works offline with selective sync (text first, images later).
about.p2_desc: Every automatic decision can be overridden and edited manually by the relevant authority.
about.p3_desc: The digital badge (Barcode/NFC/QR) is the single ID for students, teachers and visitors.
about.p4_desc: App + SMS + Gmail + instant multi-channel notifications.
about.p5_desc: Each user sees only what their role allows; the principal has full oversight.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta_description: IDAROOM's privacy policy: what data we collect, how we use it, user rights, and retention.
privacy.og_description: How IDAROOM protects the privacy of students, parents and staff.
privacy.intro: We value your privacy. This page explains, in plain language, how we handle data for students, parents and staff on IDAROOM.
privacy.s1_body: We only collect what's needed to run the school: full name, email, class, attendance records, behavior notes, grades, and the RFID card ID when issued. We don't collect location data or use advertising trackers.
privacy.s2_body: Data is used solely to power features requested by the user or the school: showing attendance to the parent, issuing certificates, school notifications, and admin reporting. We never sell data to third parties.
privacy.s3_body: Access is limited by RLS policies: a student sees only their own data, a parent sees only their children, a teacher sees only their class students, and admins see school-wide data. No one outside the institution accesses user data.
privacy.s4_body: The school keeps data for as long as the student or staff member is enrolled. On account deletion, personal data is removed within 30 days, keeping only school records legally required (transcripts, certificates).
privacy.s5_body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data. Contact your school administration or use your profile page to update information directly.
privacy.s6_body: All traffic is encrypted over HTTPS. Passwords are hashed. Profile images live in private buckets. We run daily backups.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.meta_description: IDAROOM's terms of use: responsibilities, restrictions, usage rights, and account suspension policy.
terms.og_description: The terms that govern the use of IDAROOM by institutions and users.
terms.intro: The terms that govern your use of IDAROOM. Please read them carefully.
terms.s1_body: By using IDAROOM you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
terms.s2_body: Accounts are created by the educational institution. Users are responsible for keeping their password confidential and for all activity on their account. Report any unauthorized use immediately.
terms.s3_body: You may not use the platform for any unlawful purpose, to enter false data, for harassment, or to attempt to breach the system. The institution may suspend any account that violates these terms.
terms.s4_body: The platform, its brand, and its interfaces belong to IDAROOM's owner. Data entered by users or the institution remains theirs; the platform only processes it to deliver the service.
terms.s5_body: The service is provided "as is". We do our best to keep it available and to protect data, but we don't guarantee it will be free of errors or interruptions. Administrative and educational decisions remain the responsibility of the operating institution.
terms.s6_body: We may update these terms. Institutions will be notified of any material change at least 15 days before it takes effect.
terms.s7_body: These terms are governed by the laws of Algeria; disputes are resolved amicably or before the competent courts.
